column1: # The Miri tests a gate job may see stopped at the 600 s budget with no verdict (decision 32.68):
# every finishing row of Miri's table (miri-times.tsv) over 375 s, 600 s over the 1.6 times slower
# runner the plan allows, whose test such a runner can take to the stop. Written by
# `kernel-quality miri-may-stop` (and `miri-times`) from the table, never by hand. A test on it that
# is stopped is named in its job's summary as stopped, not passed; any other test stopped fails its
# job. It may only shrink (`geom_test::miri::MAY_STOP_MOST`): each test on it is to be resized under
# cfg(miri), the same law on a smaller input, until Miri finishes it within 375 s.
